findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 246 requests to 58 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 2.0 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 776 kB (38%) came from third-party domains, 744 kB of it from services classified as tracking (227 requests).

136 cookies were set by third-party domains (148 cookies in total).
The address redirected 1 time(s): https://www.theguardian.com/ -> https://www.theguardian.com/us

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 80 requests were blocked. The page still made 246 requests to 58 third-party domains, including 45 tracking services in our list.
